entry_state: The representation keeps literal source evidence, interpreted meaning, admitted information and committed accounting separate. Concrete reference, rounding, clock and treaty cases show why later corrections change selected conclusions without rewriting prior views or authorizing journals; the literature chapter now needs to justify the proposed methods.
exit_state: The cited fields supply distinct accounting, database, identification, language, extraction and solver contributions. Their limits leave an integration problem rather than an established novel or superior product; architecture must connect those contributions through a shared representation and testable alternatives.
findings: The chapter distinguishes adopted principles from local extensions and explicitly qualified source gaps. Accounting conservation is separated from admissible transactions; incomplete information from probability; compiler correctness from accounting correctness.
Extraction metrics and solver execution are not promoted into financial interpretation or completeness. The final section explicitly leaves originality and empirical advantage unestablished.
